title: § 28-312.3 Audible notification of expiration of useful life of carbon monoxide alarms.

blocks.html:
All carbon monoxide alarms installed after April 25, 2012 shall comply with UL 2034 and be of a type that emits an audible notification at the expiration of the useful life of such alarm.
(Am. L.L. 2016/157, 12/6/2016, eff. 5/1/2019; Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2011/075, L.L. 2013/112, L.L. 2016/157, and L.L. 2021/126.
